correctness.rationale: For the repaired RESULT.md and SLOGAN.txt. The frozen headline called E_* a maximum sustainable effort, in contradiction with the strict persistence test. The replacement states that it is an unattained supremum and includes the all-finite-efforts conclusion at equality R=R_c. The actual end-of-season recurrence is verified against Kumar (4)–(5); reciprocation gives an attracting positive stock only for rF>1 and linear growth of reciprocal biomass at rF=1. The eigenvalues follow from trace and discriminant, with slow projection weight obtained from 1ᵀAv=−c−qE(1−R). Strict effort decrease follows by Duhamel differentiation and positivity of the first-patch mass under the flow. In the uniform expansion at h=qE→∞, the slow exponent correction is Tm²R(1−R)/h and the weight correction is 2mR(1−R)/h. Their sum after multiplication gives the stated C(R); the fast mode is exponentially small. The no-effort value and strict increase of f give the unique interior Lambert-W threshold; F(E,R_c)>f(R_c) for all finite E by strict decrease. Continuity rules out any bounded subsequence of cutoff efforts as R rises to R_c, so the uniform expansion at the moving root divided by (f(R_c)−f(R))/(R_c−R) gives C(R_c)/(q f′(R_c)). Independent illustrative replay: python3 /workspace/branches/fishery_replay.py, nonnegative Poisson uniformization and bisection, reproduces R_c=0.876756832620, coefficient 0.261680835745, and efforts 13.735591200, 52.636418975, 261.983722289 at the three gaps shown. The uploaded verifier was read, not run; these examples are not the proof.

value.rationale: The quantitative effort scale near a pre-existing reserve boundary is a natural unresolved question of the model, not another numerical root or a re-expression of R_c. The two finite-harvest mechanisms jointly determine a positive coefficient throughout the parameter domain, and the equality case distinguishes arbitrarily large finite effort from the neutral limiting map. This is a deterministic persistence result, not an empirical or optimal-effort recommendation.
